text.short: West Hollywood. Twenty courses from Aitor Zabala, who cooked at elBulli. The most expensive table in Los Angeles, and the only three-star one in this directory.
text.today: A counter, a tasting menu, and a drinks pairing you cannot decline. Reported at $645 a head on relaunch and $745 to $785 with the mandatory pairing; pairings run $150 for mocktails, $190 half and half, and $225, $415 or $1,000 for wine.
text.note: Euskal Kazeta files it under Basque and Catalan. It belongs to the same directory as a $5 pintxo in Elko, and the distance between those two numbers is the point of printing both.

seating.note: A chef's counter, booked ahead through Resy.
